conditions.cohort: Rock, City-pop, Pop-band; all seeds 301-308, selected before the combined implementation was frozen
conditions.comparison: Normal complete compositions; first eight-bar 4/4 instrumental lead chorus measured. Raw backing changes are reported separately; no transplant output replaces the measured score.
conditions.measurement: Descriptive score analysis only; no separate audio export/model jobs, subjective judgments or production retuning. Normal Session::compose internally renders for automatic balance.
conditions.pitch: Step is an absolute interval of 1 or 2 semitones; leap is at least 5. Whole consecutive-note ratios include rests; connected ratios require no positive gap after nearest-sixteenth quantization. Repeated pitches are neither steps nor leaps.
conditions.rhythm: Existing seed_metrics nearest-sixteenth grid; diversity counts exact onset/duration and pitch-interval signatures, retaining chorus/bar phase.
conditions.continuity: Existing melody_continuity definitions; early stationary IOI >=2 beats strictly spans beat three and begins before it. Ending bars 4/8 are analyzed separately.
conditions.phrases: Existing phrase_descriptives exact written ticks, nonoverlapping two/four-bar blocks; carries and rests retained. Six two-bar comparison pairs and one four-bar pair per chorus.
conditions.aggregation: Per-preset and all-case unweighted means; pooled step/leap ratios also reported with transition counts. No combined quality score.
conditions.previous_201_202: Historical regression cases, not members of this new generalization cohort

normal_composition_backing_audit.cause: The unchanged arrangement pass attenuates retained support attacks by 0.90 and removes non-pillar attacks while a busy lead sounds. The new delayed lead entries expose existing support attacks: attenuation is absent on 414 common notes, and 12 formerly removed notes survive in two cases. Every added onset is covered by a sounding lead before and uncovered after. Normal Session::compose calls balance_now, which measures individual tracks then applies a common mix lift; changed lead/support audio therefore changes track gains, including otherwise unchanged bass/drums. IDs, instrument state, routing, pan, effects and loudness targets match exactly.
normal_composition_backing_audit.audio_scope: No separate audio export or model jobs; normal Session::compose internally renders for automatic balance. These are normal compositions, distinct from the separate 44-audio fixed-backing experiment.

path_convention: Artifact paths are repository-relative. Public model cache references use huggingface-cache/, and external executables use external-tools/. SHA-256 values are unchanged. Absolute local manifests remain in the ignored experiment folder.
